facts.text: I've been gone a long time, Diana. The clothes look worse and the food looks better.
facts.why: Invented. Steve's real 1984 clothes joke is 'Parachute pants?' and 'Does everybody parachute now?'

facts.text: Steve discovers fanny packs and breakdancing.
facts.why: Steve wears a fanny pack in the film (widely covered), and Diana shows him break dance in the subway scene per the transcript.
facts.fix: Steve discovers fanny packs and parachute pants.

vibe.verdict: A fun 1984 mall with the dinner date, jet and Dreamstone in the right places, and the food is good if a bit safe.
